title: TCLK Signature Airlock Response Envelope
$comment: Signature-only return across the custody boundary. additionalProperties is false so a signer cannot append material we never asked for, and the runtime sentinel in blackbox/airlock/envelope.mjs also rejects secret-SHAPED values in case a compromised or buggy signer hides one in an allowed field. The envelope carries no key material, no seed and no passphrase, and its acceptance is decided by blackbox/airlock/verify.mjs against the frozen approval, not by this schema alone: a schema-valid response whose signature does not verify over the APPROVED bytes is refused.

requestId.description: Must equal the approved request id. A signature for any other request is a confusion attack.

signerDid.description: Must equal the approved signer DID; the verifier resolves the public key from this did:key and from nothing else.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature, unpadded, as the canonical local agent returns it. Verified over room|nonce|approvedPayload.

canonicalHash.description: Must equal the approved canonical hash.

room.description: Destination the signer signed for. Must equal the approved intendedRoom: the room is inside the signed preimage, so a changed room means a different signature.

nonce.description: Reserved by the signer inside custody, never chosen by the airlock. Reported here so local verification can reconstruct the exact signed preimage.

signerKind.description: Phase 3A only ever produces TEST_VECTOR_SIGNER or MOCK_SIGNER. TRUSTED_LOCAL_SIGNER is reserved for a future phase and is not reachable from this build.

signedAt.description: Local metadata. Proves nothing about ordering at the venue.

responseFingerprint.description: sha256 over every other field of this envelope. Detects post-return edits to the returned artifact itself.
